welcome.body: Everything you record —projects, crews, plans, photos and 811 tickets— is saved under your company. Only you and your team see it.

landing.cta: Try it free with my plan

hero.title: Your whole fiber job progress, <accent>in one tap</accent>.
hero.sub: Today's footage, every crew and the 811s about to expire — without calling anyone.
hero.ctaNote: See it working right below · 14 days free, no card

problem.q1: Digging for a segment photo across WhatsApp and three phones?
problem.q2: End the day without knowing how many feet each crew ran?
problem.q3: Getting a damage claim for a line your people never touched?
problem.q4: Your crew won't fill out the app because it's in English?
problem.l1: Every week you lose hours rebuilding what you already did — and sometimes the invoice still doesn't go through.
problem.l2: Two out of three contractors have already gotten a claim for damage they didn't cause.
problem.l3: Six months of this and you're in the same spot — with six months less proof saved.
problem.source: Source: excavation contractor survey, Associated General Contractors of America.

solution.title: It's not that you work badly. The proof of your job lives in five places at once.
solution.s1: Upload the plan as PDF or photo and tap the segment you built.
solution.s2: Add the GPS photo and the 811 ticket number.
solution.s3: You get proof ready to send: feet, crew, date, location.

services.title: What it solves.
services.s1Body: Mark the day's production on the plan —PDF or photo— and keep the 811 tickets tied to each segment, with a warning before they expire.
services.s2Body: When a claim comes in, pull the segment's Field Proof: marked plan, GPS photo, date, crew and 811 number. In seconds, ready to respond.
services.contactBody: We answer you personally. No sales calls.
services.emailSubject: More information about EA Fiber Track

inside.note: Reference frames — real screenshots go in once the app is ready.

offer.title: One price. <accent>No fine print.</accent>
offer.priceNote: One plan. Unlimited crews and people. Cancel anytime.
offer.f1: Full EA Fiber Track — plans, GPS photos, 811 and crews, unlimited people
offer.f2: No charge per worker or per crew
offer.f3: 811 expiration alerts by email and in the app
offer.f4: Your record follows you from one project to the next
offer.trialNote: 14 days free · no card to try · payment by Stripe

guarantee.title: The First Proof Guarantee
guarantee.body: If within 14 days you haven't built your first Field Proof with your own plan, you send an email and we refund everything. No form, no questions.
guarantee.floor: Plus 30 days to get your money back from the first charge.

faq.q1: We already do it with Excel and WhatsApp.
faq.a1: That's not a system — it's a treasure hunt when the claim arrives. Time what it takes you today against 30 seconds.
faq.q2: My people won't fill out another app.
faq.a2: That's why it's in Spanish and it's one photo plus two taps, not a form. The foreman closes the day's report in a minute.
faq.q3: We already use the general contractor's platform.
faq.a3: That one's the GC's and they take it away when the contract ends. EA Fiber Track is your record: you take it to every project.
faq.q4: I don't want to pay per worker.
faq.a4: We don't charge per worker. It's one price per company: $30 a month, with unlimited people and crews.
faq.q5: In many areas I don't have good signal.
faq.a5: Capturing photos and marks works with no signal. It uploads on its own when the connection comes back.
faq.a6: No. EA Fiber Track keeps the evidence and warns you about expiration. The official locate status is always verified with your state's 811.

final.title: Let the app tell you how the job went.
final.body: It's Friday, 6 p.m. You open EA Fiber Track: feet per crew, 811s up to date, every segment proven. You put the phone away.
final.ps: PS: EA Fiber Track shows your whole fiber job in one tap, with Field Proof behind every segment. One price: $30/mo for the whole company, 14 days free and the First Proof Guarantee.
